in_marathi.name: Girisha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Mountains
in_marathi.long_meaning: Girisha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Girisha is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Giri', meaning mountain. It is a name for the lord of mountains, often associated with Shiva, who is revered as the deity of the mountains and the destroyer of evil.
